Callout.Name: Bus in Collision
Callout.Message: Bus in collision with a car, passengers on board.
Callout.Advisory: Passengers shaken, one with a head injury.

Script.Line: I hit my head on the handrail. I was standing up.
The bus went into the back of the car and everybody came forward.
There are people in the aisle and two of them are not getting up.

Callout.Patient: I hit my head on the handrail. I was standing up.

Lines.Approach: There are passengers on it and one of them has taken a knock to the head. The driver is not hurt.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
